name: Messaging Platforms (Telegram + WeCom)
description: Declarative messaging platform adapters for CoTree's gateway: Telegram (Bot API long-polling) and WeChat Work / WeCom (企业微信 app messages). Personal WeChat has no official bot API, so the WeChat-family adapter targets WeCom. Auth via environment variables only - no embedded keys.

telegram.description: Telegram Bot API (long-polling inbound + sendMessage outbound).

wecom.description: WeCom app messages (webhook callback inbound + access_token send outbound).
